§6Gasoline§f

§aHigh-grade fuel from naphtha  -  burn it, toss it, or lead it for more power!§f

Gasoline is made from §bNaphtha§f in the Chemical Plant: §e1,000mB§f Naphtha yields §e800mB§f Gasoline. It provides §e605 kTU§f and §e1.51 MHE§f per bucket, making it a solid generator fuel.

§6Leaded variant§f:
§b•§f 10,000mB Gasoline + Tetraethyllead in Chemical Plant yields 12,000mB Leaded Gasoline.
§b•§f Leaded gives §e907 kTU§f and §e2.26 MHE§f per bucket, roughly 50% more.
§b•§f Also works in the Industrial Mixer.

§6Other uses§f:
§b•§f Napalm B: Gasoline + Slimeball in Blast Furnace.
§b•§f Tossable Gas Can: Throwable fire bomb from any gasoline container.
§b•§f Chainsaw fuel.

§cWARNING:§f Leaded Gasoline adds heavy metal pollution, making nearby glyphids stronger. Use regular gasoline for daily operations!
